title: Detailed rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- stem -->
    <path d='M50 62 L50 96' stroke='#3fbf5a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- leaf left -->
    <path d='M50 78 Q34 72 28 80 Q35 86 50 80 Z' fill='#3fbf5a'/>
    <path d='M50 78 Q38 76 32 80' stroke='#8fe8a0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

    <path d='M50 70 Q66 64 72 72 Q65 78 50 72 Z' fill='#2fa84a'/>
    <path d='M50 70 Q62 68 68 72' stroke='#8fe8a0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

    <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='24' fill='#d81b44'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='24' fill='#e8325a' opacity='0.5'/>
    <!-- petal shading arcs -->
    <path d='M50 11 Q68 15 73 34' stroke='#a80f33' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M73 34 Q71 52 56 56' stroke='#a80f33' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M44 56 Q30 52 27 34' stroke='#a80f33' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M27 34 Q28 16 44 12' stroke='#a80f33' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- mid petals -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='17' fill='#f0436c'/>
    <path d='M50 17 Q64 20 67 34' stroke='#c81c46' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M67 34 Q65 48 53 51' stroke='#c81c46' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M47 51 Q34 48 33 34' stroke='#c81c46' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M33 34 Q34 20 47 18' stroke='#c81c46' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- inner swirl -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='10' fill='#ff6b8e'/>
    <path d='M50 24 Q60 26 60 34 Q60 42 50 44 Q41 44 40 35 Q40 28 47 27' stroke='#e0345e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- heart of the rose -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='4.5' fill='#ffd0da'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='2' fill='#ff9fb4'/>
    <!-- petal tips highlight -->
    <path d='M50 12 Q58 13 64 18' stroke='#ff9fb4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M38 18 Q44 13 50 12' stroke='#ff9fb4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
